notes.title: Spring Sale & New Game: ‘DYPING ESCAPE’ Store Page Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello!

A cafe simulation game in COVID-19 disaster,  "Tokyo Coffee: Grinding in the Pandemic" is now on Spring Sale!
Enjoy our biggest discount ever—30% OFF! Don't miss this chance to grab it!

Also, our latest game "Dyping Escape" now has a store page!
The horror typing game "Dyping", played over 250,000 times, has received a massive upgrade and is now officially released.
In this dying-typing game, the words you type become reality and turn against you.

Add it to your wishlist and support us—we’d really appreciate it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406810/Dyping_Escape/

notes.title: "Tokyo Coffee: Grinding in the Pandemic" is Available in French now!
notes.notes:
You can now play the Corona Disaster nostalgic cafe game, "Tokyo Coffee: Grinding in the Pandemic" in French!
We hope you enjoy the story that begins just before the opening ceremony of the Paris Olympics at a cafe in Tokyo!

notes.title: "Tokyo Coffee: Grinding in the Pandemic" has been released!
notes.notes:
The Corona Disaster nostalgic cafe game "Tokyo Coffee: Grinding in the Pandemic" has finally been released!
This game is available on 15% OFF now.

We created this game with our thoughts and feelings so that people can sort out the Corona Disaster, which is becoming the past, as a nostalgic memory.
We hope you will enjoy it!

notes.title: The release of “Tokyo Coffee: Grinding in the Pandemic” will be postponed to 8/9
notes.notes:
“Tokyo Coffee: Grinding in the Pandemic”, a nostalgic cafe game by Corona Disaster, was scheduled to be released on 7/27/2024, To allow time for debugging and game balance adjustment, the release date has been postponed to 8/9/2024.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to our supporters.
We hope you will put this game on your wish list and await the release of this game!
